# Darrens Garage Services

> Family-run independent garage in Eastbourne, East Sussex, offering vehicle servicing, repairs and diagnostics on all makes and models. MOT testing coming soon.

Darrens Garage Services is based at Unit 1, 64 Belmore Road, Eastbourne, East Sussex, BN22 8BP, UK. Trading for 18+ years, the garage provides honest, reliable workmanship at fair prices on all car makes and models. Open Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00 (closed Saturday and Sunday). Phone 01323 724241, mobile/WhatsApp 07815 981 647.

## Services

- [Servicing](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/servicing): Interim and full services on all makes and models, protecting your warranty.
- [Repairs](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/repairs): Engine, gearbox and clutch repairs carried out by experienced mechanics.
- [Diagnostics](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/diagnostics): Modern engine diagnostics to find faults fast, petrol and diesel.
- [Brakes & Clutches](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/brakes-clutches): Brake checks, pads, discs and clutch replacement.
- [Tyres & Alignment](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/tyres-alignment): Tyre fitting, puncture repairs, wheel balancing and alignment.
- [Batteries & Electrics](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/batteries-electrics): Battery testing and replacement, plus car electrical fault-finding.
- [Exhausts & Suspension](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/exhausts-suspension): Exhaust systems, steering adjustment and suspension work.
- [MOT Testing](https://darrensgarageservices.co.uk/services/mot-testing): MOT testing bay coming soon — sign up to be notified at launch.
